name: alfer
description: Look up and propose records in one Alfer company: sales, income, expenses, clients, appointments, and visits.

interface.longDescription:
Alfer connects ChatGPT to one company the user chooses. It can look up sales, income, expenses, cash flow, clients, products, services, appointments, and clinical visits when that company uses them.

New records are only proposals. ChatGPT can draft a client, sale, income, expense, appointment, or visit, and Alfer saves it only after the user confirms. It cannot edit or delete existing records, and it does not read or write clinical notes, odontograms, or photos.
capabilities: Look up sales, income, and expenses
Look up clients, appointments, and visits
Propose new records the user confirms
defaultPrompt: Busca a un cliente por nombre

positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected company's sales for the current month, with amounts, and do not include another company.
Return today's appointments for the connected company, including time and client when available.

positive.prompt: Busca a un cliente por nombre.
positive.expected_behavior: Ask for the name if it is missing, then return matching clients from the connected company only.

positive.prompt: Muéstrame los ingresos y egresos de los últimos meses.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the same six-month income and expense series shown on the Alfer home screen.

positive.description: Propose a new client and wait for confirmation
positive.prompt: Quiero registrar un cliente nuevo de prueba. No lo guardes hasta que yo confirme.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepare a draft for the new client and do not save it until the user explicitly confirms with confirmar_registros.

negative.prompt: Borra a un cliente de la empresa.

negative.description: Do not edit an existing sale
negative.prompt: Cambia el monto de una venta que ya está registrada.

negative.description: Do not open clinical notes or the odontogram
negative.prompt: Muéstrame las notas clínicas y el odontograma de un paciente.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release. Connects one Alfer company over OAuth and can look up operations or propose new records that the user confirms before they are saved.

es-ES.subtitle: Datos del negocio en el chat
es-ES.description:
Alfer conecta ChatGPT con una empresa que la persona elige. Puede consultar ventas, ingresos, egresos, flujo de caja, clientes, productos, servicios, citas y visitas clínicas cuando la empresa las usa.

Los registros nuevos son solo propuestas. ChatGPT puede preparar un cliente, una venta, un ingreso, un egreso, una cita o una visita, y Alfer lo guarda recién cuando la persona confirma. No puede editar ni borrar registros existentes, ni leer o escribir notas clínicas, odontograma o fotos.
